header.title: List Filters & Sorting — Custom Fields
header.description: Choose which custom fields appear as filters on each list page (applies to everyone). Each enabled field adds a searchable multi-select to that page's filter bar; turning it off hides the filter and stops loading its values. Sortable applies where custom-field column sorting is available.

emptyState: No custom fields configured for this institute yet.

utm.title: Campaign (UTM) filters
utm.description: Filter this list by the campaign, source, medium and channel that brought each person in. Switches on automatically when Campaign Links (UTM) are enabled in Settings; turn it off here for lists that don't need it.
utm.disabledHint: Campaign Links (UTM) are switched off for this institute, so no campaign filters can be shown.

builtIn.title: Built-in filters
builtIn.description: Turn off the filters this institute doesn't use. They disappear from the list's filter bar.
